verdict_reason: G0 novelty FAIL. The core mechanism (build a compressed ordered support structure during binning and consume it in both forward and backward without dense per-pixel O(A) global materialization) is already published on the raster path in gsplat packed/sparse active-tile forward/backward (isect_tiles + rasterize_to_indices_in_range, packed=True/sparse_grad=True) and structurally in 3DGART. Per preregistered G0 rule, same-mechanism prior art => STOP regardless of work counts.

gates.G0_novelty_evidence: PRIOR_ART_MATRIX.md; collision = gsplat packed/sparse active-tile fwd/bwd (#3) + 3DGART backward-buffer pattern (#4); per-row ellipse math = Speedy-Splat/AccuTile (#1). Citation-integrity flag: FlashGS is arXiv:2408.07967 (Aug 2024), not 'CVPR 2025 FlashSplat/multi-resolution'.
gates.G1_cpu_correctness_evidence: 400/400 SPD property tests pass; dense-vs-sparse parity exact (0.0) on rgb/gcol/gopa/gmean for seeds 42/123, reproduced faithfully. CAVEAT: parity test is NON-INDEPENDENT (dense and sparse share alpha/composite/gradient code; can only catch row-interval culling bugs). Independent finite-difference check (scratch_audit/fd_gradcheck.py) confirms analytic opacity/mean2d/color gradients match central FD to ~1e-9. Native fp32/clamp/sort/SH/absgrad parity NOT TESTED by design.
gates.G2_representation_density_evidence: REAL room cohort (8 cameras, FastGS, N=572546, 1600x1066): real kernel intersections are ~2% of the conservative per-tile footprint (footprint_tiles/real_intersect median 50.4) — the existing renderer already achieves >>5x over its own conservative footprint. The proposed row-span candidate stream is ~6.8x DENSER than the footprint it replaces (rowspan/footprint median 6.79). stream_candidate/tile_bbox gate <=0.35 and active-hit gate <=0.20 both FAIL.
gates.G3_data_robustness_evidence: Real projected data located and authenticated (Tier-1 native_tiles_*.npz + sidecar). BUT oracle validate() hard-asserts SPD and drops the 99.76% conics that gsplat zero-pads for culled Gaussians; no dense fallback path for non-SPD/near-singular conics, so the preregistered near-singular robustness scenario is NOT testable with the shipped code.
gates.G4_headroom_evidence: No GPU / no same-hardware Faster-GS fused f captured. On real data the existing renderer's exact opacity+ellipse culling already removes ~98% of footprint candidates, so residual addressable fraction of binning/intersection build is small and already occupied; Amdahl ceiling far below f>=2/3 needed for 3x.
gates.G5_cost_evidence: Per-row span materialization ~6.8x the candidate bytes of the per-tile footprint it replaces, PLUS an added CSR/segment pass on top of gsplat's already-shipped packed per-tile index. Net more global bytes + build traffic than current renderer. Optimistic full-step upper bound <1.0x; cannot reach preregistered >=1.30x with nonnegative memory budget.

preregistered_outcome_rule: P0 verdict: STOP for G0 fail or G1 fail; HOLD if real data/native semantics/model unavailable; P0_CANDIDATE_ONLY only if G0 truly distinct AND G1/G2/G4/G5 all pass.
outcome_rule_application: G0 = FAIL (and G2 = FAIL, G5 = FAIL) => STOP. Not P0_CANDIDATE_ONLY (G0 not distinct). Not HOLD (real data IS available; the STOP is on novelty/cost, not on data availability).
p0_authorizes: NOTHING. A P0 pass would only authorize a proposed P1 experiment, not GPU execution. This is a STOP, so no P1 is authorized.
failure_reasons_ranked: 1. NOVELTY: mechanism already published (gsplat packed/sparse active-tile fwd/bwd; 3DGART backward buffer).
2. COST (G5): proposed row-span stream ~6.8x denser than the structure it replaces; net negative headroom.
3. DENSITY (G2): existing renderer already culls to ~2% of conservative footprint; opportunity already captured by baseline.
4. HEADROOM (G4, BLOCKED): no measured f; Amdahl ceiling on residual gap far below 3x requirement.
5. ROBUSTNESS (G3, HOLD): oracle cannot ingest non-SPD/near-singular conics (no dense fallback).
